title: Concussion Talk Podcast - Videos
description:
Concussion Talk is a website (link below) about concussion, brain injury, rehab and life after. On Concussion Talk Podcast I talk to physiotherapists, physical therapists, doctors, researchers, athletes, and others in the brain injury and health community.  
I had a severe brain injury in 2003. After a two week coma and two years of rehab I went back to university, finished my master's degree, worked for 4 1/2 years, started doing pilates, yoga and continued swimming. I started writing Concussion Talk in 2010 and began Concussion Talk Podcast in 2015.
